notes.title: bonus update
notes.content:
so there's one trophy that's a bit of a b*%^@& to get: eat 10 mealmates rated 5 stars.

by getting this trophy you unlock the classic minigame pack which just means that 9 extra minigames (based on the original mealmate game) will become playable in party/infinite mode.

it was suggested to make this prize easier to get because you have to put in a lot of time to unlock it; the extra minigames come too late in the game.

[b]i decided to make these 9 extra minigames available straight off the bat - you do not need to unlock them anymore.[/b]

now if you get that trophy, you unlock a secret little area in explore mode. can YOU find, "The Break Room"????

(if you have previously unlocked the classic mg pack, you will automatically have access to the break room. if you are starting a new game, you will automatically have access to the 9 classic minigames in party/infinite mode).

in addition to this, i fixed a small bug in the "press the buttons as they appear" minigame which was causing grief in multiplayer.

thank you
dweedes

notes.title: medium update
notes.content:
received really great constructive feedback from a few people, so i made a couple updates based on their suggestions:

UI
- more screen resolution options, which now replace pointless menu control option
- screen resolution is remembered
- high score flag now displays a star if the minigame is perfected
- stats now show how many fashions you have unlocked

MINIGAME BALANCING
- eased difficulty of beginning of xxxx minigame
- smog clouds in smog minigame now have varying levels of transparency
- arachnid minigame difficulty increased
- more money for getting strykes in baby bumper bowling minigame

- fixed a few game-breaking bugs

thank you
dweedes

notes.title: miniscule update
notes.content:
hey it's me again with a few slight adjustments:

- minigame results now display what round you are playing / total rounds (if applicable)
- minor bug fixes
- some minigames are more fair

thank you very much for buying and playing my game
dweedes

notes.title: pre-launch update
notes.content:
just a note to self really, but after watching Vinny stream the game for a bit, i made a few improvements:

- you can quit at the end of a round in story mode now (money and items are saved and you can see results)
- more guidance in menus
- small ui adjustments

cheers
dweedes
